command -v dnf || true

printf '%s\n' '--- current failures ---'
systemctl --failed --no-pager 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- listeners ---'

command:
set -eu
TEST_TAG="continuity-$(date +%s)"
BEFORE_SUM=$(sha256sum /var/log/inventory/app.log | awk '{print $1}')
BEFORE_INODE=$(stat -c %i /var/log/inventory/app.log)
(
  exec 3>>/var/log/inventory/app.log
  printf '%s writer-before-rotation\n' "$TEST_TAG" >&3
  while :; do printf '%s writer-after-candidate\n' "$TEST_TAG" >&3; sleep 1; done
) &
WRITER_PID=$!
printf 'writer_pid=%s pre_inode=%s pre_checksum=%s tag=%s\n' "$WRITER_PID" "$BEFORE_INODE" "$BEFORE_SUM" "$TEST_TAG"
sleep 2
printf 'fd_before='; readlink "/proc/$WRITER_PID/fd/3"
/usr/sbin/logrotate --force --verbose --state /tmp/inventory-logrotate-test.status /etc/logrotate.d/inventory
sleep 2
POST_INODE=$(stat -c %i /var/log/inventory/app.log)
printf 'writer_alive_after='; kill -0 "$WRITER_PID" && printf 'yes\n'
printf 'fd_after='; readlink "/proc/$WRITER_PID/fd/3"
printf 'post_inode=%s\n' "$POST_INODE"
printf '%s\n' '--- active log after rotation ---'
tail -8 /var/log/inventory/app.log
printf '%s\n' '--- compressed archive inventory ---'
ls -lZ /var/log/inventory/app.log*.gz
printf '%s\n' '--- archive integrity/content proof ---'
gzip -t /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz
zcat /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz | tail -8
printf '%s\n' '--- preservation proof: original pre-test checksum found in archived prefix ---'
ORIGINAL_SIZE=60
ARCHIVE_PREFIX_SUM=$(zcat /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz | head -c "$ORIGINAL_SIZE" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
printf 'original_checksum=%s archived_prefix_checksum=%s match=' "$BEFORE_SUM" "$ARCHIVE_PREFIX_SUM"
[ "$BEFORE_SUM" = "$ARCHIVE_PREFIX_SUM" ] && printf 'yes\n'
printf 'same_inode_across_copytruncate='; [ "$BEFORE_INODE" = "$POST_INODE" ] && printf 'yes\n'
kill "$WRITER_PID"
wait "$WRITER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /tmp/inventory-logrotate-test.status
printf 'writer_cleaned='; if kill -0 "$WRITER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then printf 'no\n'; else printf 'yes\n'; fi
